
**Download `GlintSetup.exe`** and choose *Just for me* or *Full disk search* during setup. `Glint.exe` is the portable app.

### What's new
- One setup with two install modes (no admin / full disk search with admin)
- Keyboard shortcuts moved to Settings and can be changed there
- Cleaner search window: no footer, no accent line under the search box
- Renamed to **Glint** (settings migrate automatically)
- Executables, setup and uninstaller are digitally signed

> The signature uses a self-signed "Glint" certificate, so Windows SmartScreen may still show a warning. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
